headlines.title: Are Wall Street Analysts Predicting Monolithic Power’s Stock Will Climb or Sink?
headlines.summary: Monolithic Power has outperformed the broader market, buoyed by surging AI demand and a firmly bullish Wall Street outlook.

headlines.title: Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) Stock Looks Overvalued After Its 122% Five Year Run
headlines.summary: Monolithic Power Systems has logged powerful long term gains, yet the recent swings in its share price raise a straightforward question for you as an investor: Is the current valuation really in line with the cash flows that the business can generate and sustain over time? Over the past 5 years, Monolithic Power Systems has returned 122.4%, which puts real weight on whether the underlying cash flows are strong enough to support that kind of long haul performance.

headlines.title: Should 800V GaN Sampling Require Action From Monolithic Power Systems Stock Investors?
headlines.summary: Monolithic Power Systems has expanded its AI data center power portfolio, sampling gallium nitride based solutions for 800V architectures and reporting a 63% year over year lift in Q3 2026 enterprise data revenue. This push into 800V and GaN power designs indicates that Monolithic Power Systems is aligning product development with rising AI data center power density requirements.

headlines.title: Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) Shares Moved, What Is Drawing Attention Now?
headlines.summary: Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) drew fresh attention after its shares jumped 15.60% in New York trading on November 23, 2026, as investors reassessed its role in the AI semiconductor supply chain. The sharp move in Monolithic Power Systems comes after a choppy few months, with the share price falling 10.77% over the past day and 9.21% over the past week, yet still posting a 27.11% year to date share price return and a 29.54% total shareholder return over one year.

headlines.title: Could Monolithic Power Stock Drop 30% Again?
headlines.summary: The one number a Monolithic Power Systems holder should watch is free cash flow. That is the cash left after running the business and paying for new equipment. Over the twelve months to September 2026 it came to $606 million, down from $705 million a year earlier. Revenue rose 40.5% over the same twelve months.

description: Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. provides semiconductor-based power electronics solutions in China, Taiwan, South Korea, Southeast Asia, Europe, the United States, Japan, and internationally. The company offers direct current (DC) to DC solutions to convert and control voltages within a range of electronic systems, such as cloud-based and on-premises CPU servers and workstations, AI systems, memory, storage solutions, notebooks, infotainment, power sources, home appliances, network infrastructure, and satellite communications. It also provides alternating current (AC) to DC; driver metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors; power management integrated circuits (ICs); and current limit switch and lighting control products. The company serves storage and computing, enterprise data, automotive, communications, consumer, and industrial end markets through third-party distributors and value-added resellers. Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is based in West Palm Beach, Florida.
